# Branch and Teller Performance Monitoring

This document outlines key operational monitoring requirements for Strategy 2026:

*   Monitor branch efficiency.
*   Monitor customer wait time.
*   Review branch efficiency standard updates.
*   Urgently monitor teller performance.
*   Optimize teller performance for Strategy 2026.
